LISTENING ROOM • A SPACE FOR YOUR SOUNDMade for listening a little closer.
YOUR MUSIC, YOUR CONTROL

A private listening room.

This version requests read-only access to your Spotify top artists, top tracks, and recently played tracks. It cannot edit playlists, control playback, or see your password.

Access and refresh tokens are kept in this tab’s session storage so your connection survives refreshes. They are not sent to this website’s server. Disconnect clears the saved session. Closing the tab normally ends it; browsers may restore the session when restoring closed tabs. Login verification also uses temporary session storage.

Disconnect clears this tab’s data. To revoke Spotify authorization too, remove Listening Room from your Spotify connected apps.

Listening Room does not send your listening data to AI models or analytics services. This beta displays Spotify-returned rankings and records. Complete listening hours, lifetime play counts, and recommendations are not available. Exploration uses artist genre tags only when returned; missing tags remain Unknown. Likely ASMR / noise recordings are automatically excluded using metadata labels and returned artist genre tags. No audio is analyzed; ambiguous tracks stay included. Exploration settings stay in memory and are cleared on disconnect.

SPOTIFY REDIRECT URI FOR THIS ADDRESS

For a new developer app, add this exact URI in its settings and add your Spotify account under Users and Access if needed.
